title: Implement Stage 2 actor service observations
summary: Add behavior-neutral versioned actor service records and bounded epoch aggregation while preserving the legacy shard drain and deferring every forceable Stage 2 policy.
planned_changes: Define disabled and observe-only connection configuration; add the versioned immutable observation and fixed-field epoch accumulator; capture existing queue, service, wake, work-kind, effect, follow-on, lifecycle, skip, and fault primitives; keep missing runnable, oldest-item, deadline-lateness, and work-unit state explicit; add machine-readable schemas and semantic validation; test sink neutrality, sequence, aggregation, reset, and existing shard correctness; then design an exact post-service export boundary before permanent campaign emission.
verification_plan: Build in Release before testing. Run REQ-QUIC-CRT-0181, existing shard, deadline, work-item layout, receive-buffer ownership, stream-capacity, flow-control, metrics, cancellation, disposal, and terminal tests. Validate observation and epoch schemas plus semantic count and sequence rules. Run manual or nightly cost and allocation checks outside correctness CI before enabling permanent high-volume export. Do not force actor_work_quantum or claim fairness or performance improvement.
out_of_scope: Large campaign execution, dataset normalization, or ML analysis
